_doc: The player model AND its hit geometry: the client draws every part (web/assets/models/player.js) and the server ray-traces every part with hit != false (internal/game/hitbox.go), both posed by the same function of the replicated state (pos, yaw, pitch, crouch). Boxes: c = centre, s = full size (metres), in the player's frame (feet at the origin, -Z forward); 'crouch' overrides c/s when crouched. Parts with 'pivot' are rotated by the view pitch about that point (c is then relative to the pivot). region picks the damage multiplier; team limits a part to one team's outfit. color: a palette name, 'team', or 'team*k' for a shade.
